title: OptiPlus-Crystal
description: Removes the round-trip wait between clicking obsidian and seeing an end crystal appear.
body:
# 💎 OptiPlus Crystal

> **Zero-wait end crystal placement — now on Minecraft 1.20 through 26.2**

---

## What it does

OptiPlus Crystal removes the round-trip wait between clicking a block and seeing your end crystal appear. The instant you click a valid spot, a client-side "ghost" crystal is placed right away, so placement feels single-player-snappy no matter your ping. The real server crystal silently takes its place once it arrives.

No more waiting on the server to acknowledge your click, and no stuttery placement loops during crystal PvP.

## Features

- Instant, ping-independent end crystal placement

- Client-side only — works on any server, nothing needed server-side

- One jar for every version — it auto-detects your Minecraft version and just works

- Lightweight, Fabric

## Supported versions

A single jar now runs on **Minecraft 1.20 → 26.2**: 1.20, 1.20.1–1.20.6, 1.21–1.21.11, 26.1 and 26.2 (Fabric, client-side). Just drop it into your mods folder.

## Server opt-out

Server admins can disable OptiPlus per-player by sending a plugin-message on one of these channels when a player joins:

- optiplus:disable — disable everything

- optiplus-crystal:disable — disable only the crystal optimization

The flag resets on disconnect.
